rationale: Anchor: the seasonal model (best backtest MAE at h3, 121.7, tied with gbt at 119.6), which gives medians h1 1230, h2 1416, h3 1408. The hub has no submission (off-season), so no ensemble to lean on. I moved off the anchor upward for an early, accelerating start of the 2026-2027 season: NHSN admissions have climbed since mid-August (691→871→887→1062, +20% last week) and ILINet %ILI is rising sharply (0.87→0.94→1.12→1.32, +18-19% wk/wk), both above the seasonal baseline for these calendar weeks. I nudged medians to h0 1080 (observed 1062 is provisional and revises up), h1 1290, h2 1480, h3 1530. Intervals are widened well beyond the backtest bands (log sd 0.12→0.26 across horizons) because we are at a possible inflection where flu turns faster than it looks, the last observed point is a floor more than a centre, and the statistical methods disagree by up to 1.7x at h3. Right-skewed throughout.
